editions.credit: Homilies on the Epistle to the Philippians, in A Select Library of the Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, series I, vol. XIII (Homilies on Galatians, Ephesians, Philippians, Colossians, Thessalonians, Timothy, Titus, and Philemon), trans.
